summary: Feed s185_triple is degraded with 3 high-severity faults: VLAN 20 missing, 21% one-way TCP sessions, and microbursts to 3.58 Gbps overloading the 1 Gbps IDS port. IDS has incomplete bidirectional visibility and will drop traffic during bursts.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or SPAN is stripping 802.1Q tags or trunk not forwarding VLAN 20: 45% of packets arrive untagged and VLAN 20 is completely absent despite being required for the IDS.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS is blind to all traffic on VLAN 20 and cannot apply VLAN-aware policies; 45% untagged traffic loses segmentation context, reducing detection coverage for lateral movement on VLANs 10/20.

recommended_fix.why: Restore 802.1Q tags end-to-end and ensure trunk/broker forwards VLAN 20 so IDS sees required segmentation.

findings.root_cause: Asymmetric routing with incomplete aggregation: 44 of 210 TCP sessions (21%) show only one direction, indicating only one side of the conversation is tapped or broker is splitting directions to different tools without aggregating both directions to this IDS.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS requires both directions (needs_both_directions=true) for TCP reassembly and stateful detection; one-way flows cause missed handshakes, broken stream reassembly, and high false-negative rate for exploits and C2.

recommended_fix.why: Aggregate both directions of each session at the packet broker and deliver correlated bidirectional flows to the IDS so it can reassemble and inspect full sessions.

findings.root_cause: Microbursts of 3.58 Gbps in 1ms intervals overwhelm the 1 Gbps IDS port (358% of capacity, 3 overloaded intervals); no load balancing or rate control in front of the tool.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS with 1 Gbps port will drop packets during bursts despite needing full payload; drops cause missed detections, incomplete flows, and IDS evasion during peak traffic.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute traffic across 4x 1G IDS ports or upgrade to 10G with 5-tuple bidirectional hashing to absorb 3.58 Gbps bursts without drops while preserving full payload for IDS.
